title: Transfer counted as household expense
observed_behavior: Both sides of an internal transfer may be added to spending.
expected_behavior: Internal transfers must be excluded from household expense totals.

title: Refund treated as a new expense
observed_behavior: Refund may be added as a separate positive expense.
expected_behavior: Refund must be linked to the original transaction and reduce net spending.

title: Recurring payment occurrence is missing
observed_behavior: A recurring series may be marked active even when an expected payment is missing.
expected_behavior: A missing expected occurrence should be flagged for review, not silently treated as paid.

title: Transaction crosses local date boundary
observed_behavior: A UTC timestamp near midnight may belong to a different local calendar date.
expected_behavior: Reporting must use the account's configured timezone before assigning the transaction date.

title: Budget references unknown category
observed_behavior: An incoming budget request may contain a category ID absent from the taxonomy.
expected_behavior: Reject the budget request and return a category validation error.
